text:
Derek: Heads up — noticed sparkframe (heatline) charts freeze and LCP spikes on dashboard pages after yesterday's telemetry-proxy rollout. Large dashboards (50+ series) hang for ~2s on first interaction.
Sam: :eyes: any bundle/telemetry changes rolled together? logs?
Derek: Yep, telemetry-proxy import got inlined in main bundle for canary. Quick diff shows +140KB to main chunk and a new lazy import order change. Repro trace:
```
LongTask ~2200ms at renderMain -> parseTelemetry -> initSampler
Module parse: /telemetry/proxy.js (+140KB)
```
Alex: Which canary and region? canary id?
Derek: canary-182 EU-west, deployed 2025-09-12T03:12Z
Priya: Infra shows routing policy tweak at 03:11: PREFETCH_STRATEGY=kv-affinity, PREFETCH_WINDOW=12. Lambda autoscale lagged ~45s so backend was starved for KV hits.
Sam: That explains higher cold-KV misses -> runtime requests hitting parse path more often. Could be combo: bundle bloat + missing KV cache.
Mari: Suggest immediate rollback of that telemetry import from the main chunk for stable rollout. Or at least enable deploy flag to lazy-load the sampler.
Derek: I can patch a hotfix to defer telemetry init until idle. Quick local patch worked in canary:
```
if ('requestIdleCallback' in window) requestIdleCallback(initTelemetry)
else setTimeout(initTelemetry, 2000)
```
Sam: Nice. Also can we lower PREFETCH_WINDOW to 4 in EU canary to reduce burst fanout while we investigate? @Priya can infra flip that temporarily?
Priya: Yep. Flipping PREFETCH_WINDOW=4 for EU canary now. ETA 30s. I'll also scale up dedicated chart workers by 2 while we monitor.
deploy-bot: deploy canary-182 PREFETCH_WINDOW=4 -> success at 1754329900
Derek: After flip + idle deferral I see LCP back to baseline on my repro. Can someone run a canary-run over the next 15m and confirm? :thumbsup:
Alex: Running dashboard soak now, will post numbers.
Sam: Followup items: (1) add a bundle-smoke test to CI to catch telemetry import regressions; (2) add alert when KV-miss rate > 5% for dashboards; (3) consider compiling telemetry-proxy as separate chunk.
Mari: Agree. Prioritize hotfix rollout and file a short retro to discuss preflight checks for imports that affect main chunk.
Derek: Will open PR for idle-deferral hotfix and a hotfix release once CI green. Thanks team :rocket:
